$comment: DRAFT model block for site/src/data/visual.json (branch wave2/site-launch), from vision/results/v2/TRAINING.md and train/eval-v2.json on branch wave2/visual-v2. Measured numbers only. Families that did not meet the ship criterion are listed under measured_checks_families and are not model families. The launch session decides whether model.status becomes live and whether the scanner runs train/visual-v2.json; until the scanner runs it, keep model.status draft.

model.name: GenClass visual model
model.input: the measurements GenClass takes of each element on the page (box, text, colours, image load state, hit tests); no pixels

trained_on.$note: sites: hosts of the training split. injected_faults: fault rows in the training split; 25,536 of them changed pixels at rest and were the positives. elements: hand-labelled crops (real or not) the models trained on (944 of val hosts, 311 of training hosts); the models also trained on about 440,000 injected-fault and clean element rows each.

eval.data: 1,114 labelled element crops from 871 page views of 522 sites, plus a blind hand check of other flags on the same held-out sites
eval.split: sites held out from training (split by host after near-duplicate removal)

families.name: Broken and placeholder images
families.$note: recall of the media score (media+lab) on injected media faults that changed pixels at rest, at 0.1% and 1% of clean test elements flagged. In the scanner the score only filters the measured media checks (image-broken, media-failed, text-placeholder, image-distorted) at 0.026: on labelled test crops 27 flags, 19 real bugs (0.70), 19 of 21 labelled media bugs found; the checks alone 44 flags, 19 real (0.43).

families.name: Layouts wider than the screen
families.$note: recall of the responsive score (responsive+lab) on injected responsive faults that changed pixels at rest. Shipped at 0.561: on labelled test crops 10 flags, 7 real bugs (0.70, 95% CI 0.40 to 0.89), 6 of 30 labelled overflow and responsive bugs found; blind hand check 10 of 11 other flags real (4 sites).

model.$natural_precision_note: 26 real of 37 flags of the two shipped detectors on labelled crops of held-out pages (media 19 of 27, responsive 7 of 10); unclear counts as not real. Blind hand check of other flags: media 25 of 30, responsive 10 of 11.
model.cost_measured_on: the reference JS evaluator (detect_v2.mjs), Node 22.22.0, one thread on an Azure F80ads_v7 vCPU, 21,124 test elements; 199 KB uncompressed
model.$measured_checks_note: No v2 detector for these families reached at least 60% real bugs among its flags on held-out real pages at a threshold chosen on dev; they stay on the measured checks of docs/runtime/VISUAL.md.

sources.title: Visual-bug classifier v2: training and evaluation on real pages
sources.used_for: every number in the model block
